subject: CL-1: Recon SWE-Bench-CL harness + FAISS memory interface, produce Zonoid-swap integration plan
description: Recon spike for the SWE-Bench-CL pilot (3 arms: OFF / FAISS / Zonoid; scope: one sequence ~10-20 tasks). Repo: https://github.com/thomasjoshi/agents-never-forget (paper arXiv 2507.00014). Mac-only investigation, NO Docker run needed. Clone to scratch, read the code, and produce a concrete integration plan covering: (1) how the LangGraph eval framework runs a single chronological sequence end-to-end (entry point, config, dataset/sequence structure, where SWE-bench Verified Docker images come in); (2) the FAISS semantic-memory MODULE INTERFACE — the exact functions/class the harness calls to write+retrieve memory across tasks, so we know the seam to swap; (3) the precise integration points to replace FAISS with Zonoid (search_knowledge for retrieval, record_decision/inject for write) so KB compounds across the sequence via the gated loop; (4) which ONE sequence to use for the pilot (which repo, how many tasks, runtime estimate per task) — pick a representative ~10-20 task sequence; (5) what the Windows/WSL2 x86 box needs to run it (python deps, Docker images, dataset access, API keys); (6) the 3-arm wiring (OFF=no memory, FAISS=native, Zonoid=our KB) and how the harness toggles the memory backend; (7) risks/unknowns (e.g. is the harness runnable as-is, LangGraph version pins, Docker image availability). Write the plan to bench/swe-bench-cl/INTEGRATION-PLAN.md in your worktree and commit it. Context: the FeatureBench pilot is done (bench/featurebench-kb/); the runbook docs/swe-bench-eval.md has the original CL design (replace FAISS memory module with Zonoid KB).

summary: Recon done. Integration plan committed at bench/swe-bench-cl/INTEGRATION-PLAN.md (SHA 5f9d7dd). VERDICT: clean integration, not a research slog. Use eval_v1/eval_procedure.py (the ONLY version with real SWE-bench Docker grading — v2 self-reports, its evaluator is a broken stub; the Makefile/scripts entry points are DEAD, reference nonexistent files). eval_v1 is a jupytext notebook-as-script. FAISS seam = one duck-typed MemorySystem with 3 methods (get_relevant_context_for_prompt retrieve->str, add_experience_to_memory write verified outcome, clear_memory) — swap to a ~40-LoC ZonoidMemorySystem hitting daemon HTTP /search (ungated) + /record_decision. Toggle already 2-arm (OFF=memory_disabled, FAISS=memory_enabled); 3rd Zonoid arm = one-line MEMORY_BACKEND branch at the constructor (L1105). Pilot sequence: pytest-dev_pytest_sequence (19 tasks, 8/8/3 easy/med/hard, 37% have CL dependencies). Windows: amd64 Docker native (planned), pin UNPINNED deps (langchain/faiss-cpu/swebench — requirements.txt is dataset-construction only), one LLM key + Ollama-or-OpenAI embeddings, switch SWE-bench clone from SSH to HTTPS. TOP RISK: dependency rot (unpinned langchain churn). KEY UNKNOWN to confirm before the run: daemon /search + /record_decision must accept a workspace/namespace param over plain HTTP for arm isolation (Zonoid has no clear_memory equivalent). Also note: harness grades against full SWE-bench test, not Verified — one-line change at L695 if Verified-only wanted.
